'''Gogitols''' were five-headed [[Diet/Legends|carnivores]] that inhabited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skye/Legends|Skye]]. In the [[S'kytri]] mythology, gogitols were one of the monstrous creatures that roamed the planet's cataclysmic surface until [[Hormaket]] the Vanquisher banished them to the catacombs of [[Entyrmion]].
